acceptanceObjective: Certified idle-type skills become reachable from the local behavior layer: during idle slots, with a cooldown and only in stable static state, the renderer plays a random LlmExposed certified skill through the existing PlayCertifiedMotion path (static gate, input lease, admission, pose restore); failures or rejections fall back to the legacy idle scheduler without changing its behavior.
notes: No autonomous LLM proposals and no new skills are enabled by this package; the behavior layer only re-plays already certified and LLM-exposed skills through the production executor. Idle cadence and cooldown constants stay conservative; proactive scheduling policy remains a future decision.
